content: Lepalosi ya hauꞌniya vekamo alino alagepa huno ateꞌniya gemae
Yesuꞌa avelegatiꞌmo emineꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo asole vayaꞌmo akame huꞌa emiꞌeꞌnae.
Inagi lepalosi ya hauꞌniya vekamo agaetegamo eno aleꞌya faiꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo, Ala kava nene, huno, kahauꞌnisiyana afaꞌa alika alagepa huka nategane, huno huꞌniye.
Huꞌnigeno Yesuꞌa ayaꞌmo alino ataleno agufaleꞌmo maleꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo, Nahauꞌniyanagi alagepa huka afaꞌa maiyo, huno nehigenoꞌaeꞌmo lepalosi yaꞌamo malage huno hano huꞌniye.

Yesuꞌa ha painoꞌaeꞌmo, kateꞌmo neꞌukaeꞌmo mago vayaꞌaifeꞌmo hapa opaika mono huno neꞌapateya vekalegageꞌmo uka aliꞌna alagepa huꞌna kateꞌnova kagufamo alika ave liyo. Apakaemo lepalosi yaꞌamo ago hano huꞌniye, huꞌa kagesayafeꞌmo kagufamo alika ave liteka akeyaꞌvilagamo Moseseꞌa amiyo, huno huꞌniya ofalinimo alika amiyo, huno ha paiꞌniye.
Ati vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaino neꞌapateya vekaeꞌmo ava ge huꞌniya gemae
Yesuꞌa Kapeneyamu taonifiꞌmo uno nehaigenoꞌaeꞌmo mago Lomu nofi vekamo ati vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaino neꞌapateya vekamoꞌa ha maesiyafeꞌmo ge huno afi geꞌniye.
Ala kava nene, huno, aliꞌyaꞌnimo neꞌaliya vekamo noꞌnifiꞌmo lusi kava huno agafu kiꞌnigeno alagi kanage kanaga osuno havaeno neꞌmaiye, huno ha paiꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo,
Uꞌna afaꞌa aliꞌna alagepa huꞌna ategauve, huno ha paiꞌniye.

Yagaino neꞌapateya vekamoꞌa, Ala kava nene, huno, Alagepa vekamo oꞌmaiꞌnovaꞌmofeꞌmo noꞌnifiꞌmo eka haikeka maisanafeꞌmo oꞌnahauꞌniyanagi keꞌageꞌmo hugenoꞌao aliꞌyaꞌnimo neꞌaliya vekamo hagesigeno he tino alagepa huno maino.

Mago vayaꞌmogi yagaiꞌa neꞌnategeꞌna nagaemo ati vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaiꞌna neꞌapatove. Mago vekaeꞌmo uvo, huꞌna nehugenoꞌaeꞌmo neꞌviye. Mago vekaeꞌmo eno, huꞌna nehugenoꞌaeꞌmo neꞌe. Aliꞌyaꞌnimo neꞌaliya vekaeꞌmo huꞌnaeꞌmo, ani aliꞌyaꞌmo aliyo, huꞌna nehugenoꞌaeꞌmo ani aliꞌyaꞌmo afaꞌa neꞌaliye, huno ha paiꞌniye.

Yesuꞌa ani gemo afitenoꞌaeꞌmo hau aiꞌniye. Agaemo akame nehaya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo, Lama ge lapa nepauve, huno, Nagaemo muki Isaleli vayaꞌai apaipafiꞌmo ani agufa lokiya apakesa afiꞌa fatago huꞌnaya kavaꞌapimo oꞌapakeꞌnove.

Lapa nepauve, asole vayaꞌmo Yu nofi vayapatiꞌmo oꞌmaiꞌnaya vayaꞌmo yegemo haine neꞌeya kotegatiꞌmo ege yegemo lamino nefaleya kotegatiꞌmo ege huꞌa Gotiꞌa yagaino neꞌapateya kopiꞌmo haiꞌa Emalehamuꞌagi Aisikiꞌagi Yekopuꞌagi huꞌa magokepi lokaeꞌa maiꞌneꞌa neꞌyaꞌmo neꞌa maigayaꞌmonanafa
Gotiꞌa yagaino neꞌapateya kotetiꞌmo mafaꞌneꞌamo hani kopiꞌmo alino yaga auno apatalesigeꞌapaeꞌmo malaga maiꞌneꞌa aviꞌya huge apavepiꞌmo haniꞌa agafu kige huꞌa maigae, huno huteno

yagaino neꞌapateya vekaeꞌmo, Naha maegaiye, huka kagesa afika fatago huꞌnanaꞌmofeꞌmo kaha maegauvanagi afaꞌa uvo, huno ha paiꞌnigeno ani afinaꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌamo neꞌaliya vekamo kaitaꞌamo hageꞌnigeno he tino alagepa huno maiꞌniye.
Yesuꞌa asole vayaꞌmo alino alagepa huno apateꞌniya kavafeꞌmo ava gemo huꞌniya gemae
Yesuꞌa Pita nopiꞌmo faleno haino ageyana Pita ayemoꞌamoꞌmo amuko kaitaꞌmo hauꞌnigeno havaeno maiꞌnigeno ageꞌniye.
Agaemo ageteno ayateꞌmo ayaꞌmo maleꞌnigeno amuko kaita hauꞌniya kaitaꞌamo ago hageꞌnigeno he tino neꞌyaꞌmo alo huno apamiꞌniye.

Uneꞌamo Yesutegamo asole hosu apaune vayaꞌmo vayaꞌai apaipafiꞌmo maiꞌnaya vayaꞌmo apavaleliꞌeꞌa apateꞌnae. Yesuꞌa geꞌaletiꞌmo hosu apaune vayaꞌmo vayaꞌai apaipafatiꞌmo alino hapa faitalegeꞌa uꞌnageno muki alu kaita alu kaitaꞌmo hapauꞌniya vayaꞌeꞌmo alino hapageno apateꞌniye.
Agaemo Aiyeyaꞌa Gotitegati gemo alinineno aeno hakalo huno hapa nepaiya vekamoꞌa mani kavafeꞌmo huꞌniya gemo afole aisiyafeꞌmo huꞌniye. Aiyeyaꞌa hunoꞌaeꞌmo,

content.text: Agaemo alu kaita alu kaitaꞌmo lahauꞌniya kaitaꞌmo laha maeno alinino uno ataleꞌniye,

content: huno avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniye.
Akame hisaꞌa vekalaꞌanifeꞌmo hana paiꞌniya gemae
Yesuꞌa apakeyana asole vayaꞌmogimo eꞌa faiꞌa ku aiꞌa ateꞌnageno apaketenoꞌaeꞌmo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo, mugagayaga faligamo lakaeta vigetao, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Mago neꞌmo keꞌaepa gemo avoꞌmo kaeno alino apaya neꞌmaleya vekamoꞌa agaetegamo eno ha painoꞌaeꞌmo, Tisao, huno, haiya kotegamo visapigeꞌna afaꞌa kakame huꞌna uguve, huno ha paiꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo
Yesuꞌa geꞌaleꞌmo aeno atagaina huno ha painoꞌaeꞌmo, Afela kalamogi nehavaya kelimo hanege namamogi apanoꞌmo hanege huꞌniyaꞌmonanafa Vemo mafaꞌnemo havaesiya noꞌmo ohaneꞌniye, huno ha paiꞌniye.
Mago alu vekamo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vekamoꞌmo hunoꞌaeꞌmo, Ala kava nene, huno, kanalene, huka hugeꞌnao hogoteꞌna uꞌna afoꞌnimoꞌmo aliꞌna kiꞌna ateteꞌnae, huno huꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo,
fali kavategamo neꞌmaiya vayaꞌmogimo falisaya vayaꞌapimo aliꞌa kiꞌa apategayanagi kagaemo ataleka eka nakame huvo, huno ha paiꞌniye.
Yesuꞌa yasiꞌe aniꞌefeꞌmo afaꞌa maiꞌao, huno huꞌniya gemae
Yesuꞌa sipifiꞌmo haino maiꞌnigeꞌa geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌmo akame huꞌa haiꞌa sipifiꞌmo maiteꞌa uꞌnae.

Neꞌvagenoꞌaeꞌmo malage huno ani kotuteꞌmo lusi kava huno yasimo aliꞌnigeno aniꞌmoꞌa aino holakau holakau huno haino sipifiꞌmo havaiteteno aeno lapanegefeꞌmo huꞌniyaꞌmonanafa Yesuꞌa aukeꞌmo kaleno maiꞌniye.
Geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌmogimo uꞌa hau neꞌa ateteꞌapaeꞌmo, Ala kava nene, huꞌa, hogoꞌamo ago aniꞌmo nesuna agufa kavaꞌmo nehunagi he tika lagufamo alika katika lato, huꞌa huꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo,

Aiseꞌatoꞌamo lapakesa afitapa fatago huꞌnaya vayanagi na kava higetapaeꞌmo koli nehae, huno hapa paiteno he tino yasiꞌe aniꞌefeꞌmo afaꞌa maiꞌao, huno ke hanauꞌnigeꞌana yasiꞌe aniꞌeꞌmo alagi afaꞌa haneꞌnaꞌae.
Muki vayaꞌamogimo ani kavaꞌmo ageteꞌapaeꞌmo hapau aiteꞌa, Vae, huꞌa, yasimoꞌe aniꞌmoꞌeꞌmo geꞌamo afiteꞌana afaꞌa maiꞌnaꞌagi ani vekamo na agufa vekamo maiꞌniye, huꞌa huꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa lole vekalaꞌani anaipafatiꞌmo hosu apaune vayaꞌmo alino hapa faino apataleꞌniya gemae

Yesuꞌa ani kotuꞌmo lakaeno mugagayaga faliga Gegasini vayaꞌai haopalega uno avaꞌyi nehigeꞌanaeꞌmo lole vekalaꞌmo faliꞌnaya vayaꞌmo kiꞌa neꞌapataya yafa no kapatiꞌmo eꞌana Yesuꞌeꞌmo fotu huꞌnaꞌae. Anaipafiꞌmo hosu apaune vayaꞌmo maiꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo lusi kava huꞌana negi maleteꞌana afela kavaꞌmo nehaꞌa vekalaꞌmo maiꞌnaꞌaꞌmofeꞌmo muki vayaꞌmo ani haopalegamo oꞌuꞌnae.

Anakaemo eꞌana Yesuꞌeꞌmo fotu huteꞌanaeꞌmo, Goti mafaꞌneꞌamogae, huꞌa, lagaetegamo na kava huka latesanafeꞌmo neꞌane. Kayoꞌmo lamisana afinaꞌmo afole oꞌaiꞌniyanagi lagafu kisiya yaꞌmo alika lamisanafeꞌmo neꞌapiye, huꞌa afi geꞌnae.
Asole afu anagaꞌmo aise afagiꞌaleꞌmo kahaumo neꞌa maiꞌnae.
Hosu apaune vayaꞌmogimo Yesufeꞌmo, Alika laha faika latalegefeꞌmo hukaeꞌmo asole afu anagaꞌai apaipafiꞌmo alika laha faitalegeta faletuta haita maino, huꞌa ha paiꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo,

afaꞌa viyo, huno hapa paiꞌnigeꞌa lole vekalaꞌani anaipafatiꞌmo ataleꞌa apaune heꞌa uꞌa afu anagaꞌai apaipafiꞌmo faleꞌa haiꞌnae. Faleꞌa haiꞌnageꞌapaeꞌmo muki afu anagaꞌamo aulafilagatiꞌmo nagu nagu huꞌa lamiꞌa anipiꞌmo asagauꞌa aiteꞌa aniꞌmo neteꞌa faliꞌnae.

Ani afu anagaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaiꞌa neꞌapataya vayaꞌmo apaune hetaleꞌa uꞌa taonifilagamo muki huꞌniya kavafeꞌmo ava gemo huꞌa hapa paige Yesuꞌa ani lole vekalaꞌani anaipafiꞌmo hosu apaune vayaꞌmo maiꞌnaya vekalaꞌanitegamo huꞌniya kavafeꞌmo ava gemo huꞌa hapa paige huꞌa hapa paiꞌnae.
Muki taonifiꞌmo maiꞌnaya vayaꞌmogimo uꞌa Yesuꞌmo ageteꞌapaeꞌmo, kahao ke honanagi, lagae kotetiꞌmo ataleka uvo, huꞌa ha paiꞌnae.
